description: This file contains Flutter widget classes for the Reports tab of an expense management frontend application. It includes UI components like pie chart visualization and expense category list with progress indicators, relying on an ExpenseProvider for data.

classes.name: ReportsTab
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of expense categories with progress indicators and a pie chart breakdown.

classes.name: _PieChart
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a pie chart representing expense data distribution.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: Custom painter that draws the segments of the pie chart based on expense data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ReportsTab or _PieChart, depending on context.

methods.name: _PieChart.build
methods.description: Constructs the aspect-ratio constrained pie chart with total expenses analyzed.

methods.name: _PiePainter.paint
methods.description: Draws arcs on the canvas to visualize expense category proportions in the pie chart.

methods.name: _colorFor
methods.description: Returns a consistent color for a given expense category key.
